candidate_relations.reason: The post-cardioversion prolonged, notched biphasic/negative P waves support advanced interatrial block, which together with atrial tachyarrhythmia constitutes Bayés syndrome. Chronic atrial fibrillation alone is not the full diagnosis.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: Atrial fibrillation is an associated atrial tachyarrhythmia within Bayés syndrome but does not identify advanced interatrial block; chronicity is also unsupported.
